title: Pricing
prototype: Prototype: nothing can be bought yet, no prices are set, and the split of the features over Silver, Gold and Platinum is a draft.
statusTitle: Under development, and free for now
status: TigerLegs is under development. We are looking for testers, and for now everything is completely free.
free: Loading a GPX file and getting its swim and run segments, with distances, on a map and in a table, will always be free.
tiger: Tigers are considered globally Endangered under the IUCN Red List (Panthera, 2025). Projects that are completely free and unsubsidised are also at risk of quick extinction. Membership keeps TigerLegs alive and independent.
